title: Couette Flow with Robin Boundary Condition (I): the viscosity-independent friction
summary: This article is the first paper in the series. In this series of articles, we will examine the influence of the friction factor $α$ at the solid--fluid boundary on the stability of Couette flow. Specifically, we consider the stability of Couette flow in a bounded periodic channel $\mathbb{T} \times [-1,1]$ under Robin-type boundary conditions ($u^2|_{y=\pm 1} = 0$, $[α\partial_n u^1 + u^1]|_{y=\pm1} = f $), where $α$ is the friction factor and $n$ is the unit outer normal vector.
